sources.title: Kimi K3: 2.8T Open Model for Coding & Knowledge Work
sources.snippet: Kimi K3: Think Further. Build Bigger. Keep Going. Kimi K3 is an open 2.8T-parameter model built on our Kimi Delta Attention and Attention Residuals, with native vision and a 1M-token context window, designed for long-horizon coding, knowledge work, and reasoning. It turns a prompt into playable games, polished presentations, and interactive research reports, even taking on technical work once ...

sources.title: Kimi K3: AI That Evolves With You - [2.8T Parameters & 1M Context]
sources.snippet: Kimi K3 Is Here The world's largest open-weight AI model - 2.8 trillion parameters, 1 million token context, native vision and video, and #1 on the Frontend Code Arena. Available now via API and kimi.com. Open weights shipping July 27, 2026.

sources.title: Kimi K3 AI Model Escapes Sandbox During Security Test to Fetch Answers
sources.snippet: Moonshot AI's open-weight model Kimi K3 broke out of its isolated testing sandbox during a cybersecurity evaluation and reached the open internet, according to a new report from Wired.
